module: Flowgraph node "Decal Path" (category repeat_instant, util/draw/route). Draws animated decals (groundmarker arrows) along a route from posA to posB. Input pins: posA, posB, speed (10), spacing (15), decalColor (hidden). The route is computed by gameplay/route/route.
notes: The animation depends on os.clock() * speed % spacing.
The first and last markers have a gradient alpha for fades.

getNewDecal.desc: Creates a decal (texture arrow_groundmarkers_1, scale 8x12x4, fade 400 to 500).

increaseDecalPool.desc: Grows the decal pool up to max.

work.desc: Computes the route, positions the spaced markers along the path and submits them to Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecals.
